issues.description: Class Lecture field naming mismatch: the problem statement UML and the class API use camelCase attribute names (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), but the solution implementation declares the private fields using snake_case (lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students, number_of_guest_students, number_of_lecturers, number_of_tutors). The solution's constructor and methods reference camelCase identifiers (e.g. this.lectureName) while the declared fields are snake_case, which will cause compilation errors and/confuse students comparing the solution with the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make identifier naming consistent. Preferred fix: rename the private fields in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to camelCase to match the UML and the constructor/getter/setter usages (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). Alternatively, update the constructor and all methods to consistently use the snake_case field names, but prefer camelCase to follow the problem statement and common Java conventions.
